ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-KEY

info.description:
The LeadMetrics API lets you programmatically retrieve marketing performance data and lead
information for your organization.

## Authentication

Every request must include an `X-API-KEY` header containing your organization's API key.
You can find or generate your API key inside the LeadMetrics dashboard.

```
X-API-KEY: your-api-key-here
```

Requests without a valid key receive a **401 Unauthorized** response.

## Pagination

Endpoints that return lists support cursor-free page-based pagination via `pageNumber` and
`pageSize` in the request body. The response envelope includes `totalCount`, `totalPages`,
`hasPreviousPage`, and `hasNextPage` to help you iterate.

| Parameter    | Default | Min | Max |
|-------------|---------|-----|-----|
| `pageNumber` | 1       | 1   | 200 |
| `pageSize`   | 50      | 5   | 100 |

## Attribution

Performance endpoints accept an `attributionType` field to control how conversions are
credited across the customer journey:

| Value          | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `last_click`  | Credit goes to the last ad the lead clicked before converting *(default)* |
| `first_click` | Credit goes to the first ad the lead clicked |

## Date Ranges

`fromDate` and `toDate` are required on performance endpoints and must be in `YYYY-MM-DD`
format. `fromDate` must be ≤ `toDate` and both years must fall in the range 2000–3000.

## Metrics

Use the `GET /metrics` endpoint to discover the available metric IDs for your organization.
Pass those IDs in the `metrics` array of any performance request to control which metrics
are returned. Custom metrics use `isCustom: true`.

post.description:
Returns performance data at the individual **ad** level — the most granular view available.

You can filter by specific campaigns via `campaignIds` and/or specific ad groups via
`adGroupIds`. Combining both filters narrows results to ads within those ad groups
that also belong to the specified campaigns.

200.description: Paginated list of ad performance records.

post.description:
Returns ad performance aggregated by **ad group** (also called ad sets on Meta).

You can narrow results by passing specific campaign IDs in `adCampaignIds`.
Omitting this field returns ad groups across all campaigns in the project.

200.description: Paginated list of ad group performance records.

post.description:
Returns ad performance aggregated by **campaign**.

Use this to compare performance across your campaigns within a project. You can
optionally filter to only return currently active campaigns via `onlyActiveAds`.

200.description: Paginated list of campaign performance records.

post.description:
Returns aggregated ad performance grouped by **channel** (e.g. Google, Meta, LinkedIn).

This is the highest-level view of your ad spend and results. Use it to compare overall
ROI across platforms for a given date range.

200.description: Paginated list of channel performance records.

post.description:
Returns a paginated list of leads captured for a project, including attribution data
for both the first click and last click that brought the lead in.

Each lead includes contact information (where available) and full UTM / ad attribution
for both touch points so you can analyze the customer journey.

get.description:
Returns all metrics available for your organization, including both predefined platform
metrics (impressions, clicks, spend, etc.) and any custom metrics you have configured.

Use the returned `id` values in the `metrics` array of performance requests.

Returns all projects (ad accounts / tracking projects) belonging to your organization.

Use the returned `id` as the `projectId` in performance and lead requests to scope
results to a specific project.
